instruction: Optimize differential pair escape and connector fanout. `/home/user/Desktop/seed_board.kicad_pcb` is a routable KiCad PCB with fixed anchor parts and movable optimization parts. `/home/user/Desktop/objective.json` describes the optimization objective. Use KiCad command-line tools or KiCad scripting to place/reroute the board as well as possible. Save the optimized board as `/home/user/Desktop/optimized_board.kicad_pcb` and write `/home/user/Desktop/optimization_report.json` summarizing the choices and estimated score. The evaluator returns a continuous score for pair skew and fanout cost where higher is better; the supplied ground_truth is only a baseline/reference solution. Minimize differential-pair skew between the R1/R2 escape legs while keeping bypass parts near J2. [Software] Use KiCad CLI tools such as `kicad-cli` and KiCad scripting from the terminal.
